product.title: Highlights of Holland Private Guided Tour from Amsterdam

description.text: Leave Amsterdam for a private 6- to 7-hour countryside day through Holland's windmills, fishing villages, and cheese country. Comfortable transport takes the group out of city crowds to Zaanse Schans, Marken, Volendam, and Church Broek. A private guide covers Dutch history while you taste local cheese, walk past working mills, and try on wooden shoes. Vehicle timing and village stops stay coordinated so the outing stays on rural Holland rather than self-driving between hamlets. Stops include Zaanse Schans, Marken, Volendam, Church Broek.
